problem.title: You have the data. You do not have the analyst.
problem.body: Seller Central shows revenue. Fees, COGS, ads (later), and inventory sit in other places. By the time you reconcile a SKU, the month is over — and the next decision is still a guess.
problem.clickInstruction: Hover or click a friction point to see its hidden business impact:

points.revenue: Revenue is not profit. Fees and landed cost change the ranking of every SKU.
points.inventory: Overstock and stockout risk hide inside unit counts until cash is already stuck.
points.language: Agencies and MENA operators need the same report in Arabic, Spanish, or English.

impacts.revenue: Hidden Impact: -$4,800/mo uncaptured margin on top seller due to fee miscalculations.
impacts.inventory: Hidden Impact: $18,500 cash frozen in 45-day overstock and unexpected storage penalties.
impacts.language: Hidden Impact: 12+ hours/mo wasted manually translating and reformatting client workbooks.

faq.title: Straight answers before you connect Amazon.

access.q: What Amazon access does XOLT request?
access.a: Read-only access through official Amazon SP-API via OAuth. We do not request restricted roles and we do not scrape Seller Central.

pii.q: Do you collect buyer personal data?
pii.a: No. XOLT does not collect buyer PII. AI only receives aggregated findings, never raw orders or buyer data.

trial.a: 14 days, no credit card required. You can disconnect Amazon at any time (kill switch).

languages.q: Which languages and currencies are supported?
languages.a: English, Spanish, and Arabic from day one. Currencies: AED, SAR, EGP, EUR, GBP, USD.

v1.a: No write-back to listings, prices, or bids. Ads integration is a fast-follow. Brand Analytics / SQP comes later. We are not a keyword or product-research tool.

agency.a: Yes. Agency plans include client workspaces and monthly client-ready packs. White-label is planned later.

securityPage.title: How seller data is protected
securityPage.intro: This page is a public summary of controls — not an internal runbook. We do not claim certifications that we have not earned.
securityPage.apiTitle: Official APIs only, with a kill switch
securityPage.apiBody: XOLT uses Amazon Selling Partner API with OAuth. We do not scrape Seller Central. You can disconnect the integration (kill switch) and stop data import.
securityPage.piiTitle: No buyer PII, no restricted roles
securityPage.piiBody: We do not collect buyer personal information. We do not request restricted SP-API roles.
securityPage.kmsBody: Amazon tokens are encrypted via KMS. For v1, application hosting is in the EU (Frankfurt).
securityPage.rlsBody: Seller data is isolated per tenant using row-level security (RLS).
securityPage.aiBody: The monthly action plan is generated from aggregated findings. The model does not receive raw orders or buyer data.
securityPage.links: Related: sub-processors list and privacy policy.
